Thanks Hannah — great session. A couple quick notes from our side:

- Procurement window: our monthly procurement cutoff is 2026-09-01 for contracts to hit this quarter; if we miss that we push to next quarter which will delay budget availability. Can we aim to have fully executed agreement by 2026-08-31 instead of 2026-09-15?

I reviewed the MAP and it looks good; main concern is the procurement deadline. If Redwood can compress review/turnaround on your SOW and be ready to accept our redlines quickly, we can hit 2026-08-31.
